title: Packed Boolean circuit
statement: A packed Boolean circuit consists of a positive number $n$ of input bits and a Boolean circuit on those $n$ bits. The circuit is an ordered sequence of gates, each of which reads an input bit, is a Boolean constant, or applies negation, conjunction, or disjunction to earlier gates; one gate is distinguished as the output.
hypotheses_covered: The circuit has that input length
